name: Fable: AI Product Launch - w/ elevenlabs.io voiceover
description:
A premium AI product launch film styled as a natural-history specimen plate. Rotating armillary rings, a labelled anatomy diagram, and liquid-glass integration icons that merge into one orb, over a silk-blue background. Swap the brand name, tagline, labels and icons to make it yours.

Audio Disclaimer: The voiceover used in this preview is a placeholder created using the ElevenLabs Free Plan. It is included for demonstration purposes only and is not licensed for commercial use. To use this template commercially, you must replace the audio track with your own licensed voiceover or upgrade the audio file through ElevenLabs.
